payload.description_html: Selected unenlagiid traits: (A) maxilla and dentary of Austroraptor cabazai showing the rostral process of the maxilla, the anteroposteriorly elongated postantral wall, and the sub-parallel dorsal and ventral margins of the dentary. af, antorbital fenestra; mxf, maxillary fenestra; pan, postantral wall.
